responsibility: This machine-description fragment implements MIPS synchronization and atomic memory operations in RTL. It defines the UNSPEC codes, iterators, expanders, and insn patterns for memory barriers, legacy sync_* builtins, compare-and-swap, exchange, fetch-add, and related QI/HI/SI/DI atomic operations, choosing between LL/SC retry loops and ISA-specific instructions like SWAP or LDADD and attaching the sync-loop attributes consumed by backend output helpers such as mips_output_sync_loop and mips_output_sync.
